dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: It's not often that the Akademiya hosts an event like this. We need to increase the number of patrols inside the city for this special occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: This isn't even especially for the competition. In fact, it is the increase in tourists that require us to take additional care.

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: There are no shortage of devious people who are willing to take advantage of these festivities to mask their own nefarious deeds.
